content.title: Test failure in deduplication order preservation
content.expected: The test 'deduplication preserves first occurrence order' expects the function to return ['zebra', 'ant', 'bird'] from input ['zebra', 'ant', 'zebra', 'bird'], preserving the order of first occurrences.
content.actual: The function returned ['ant', 'bird', 'zebra'], which is the sorted version of the unique elements, not the order of first occurrence.
acceptance: The test at line 5-7 in tests/unique.test.js failed with an AssertionError.
The actual output ['ant', 'bird', 'zebra'] does not match the expected output ['zebra', 'ant', 'bird'].
